verdict.reason: Supertubos is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, I’d check the cams first, and Supertubos at lunch is the best bet if it’s actually showing a bit more size than expected. Surfline consistency looks a little shaky, and the spot surf may be on the small side, so it’s one of those days where the decision really depends on what Surfline and the MEO Beachcam show. Tide is mid rising, which should help the sandbar setup, but I’m only going to drive if the bars look punchy and clean.
